method: Side-by-side visual review of v1's 38 and v2's nine additional exact-dHash candidates. dHash equality is not duplicate proof.

conservative_resolution_applied_before_v.reason: Two low-detail bright-water candidates remained inconclusive, so these groups were coalesced before v2 splitting.
conservative_resolution_applied_before_v.verification: Both groups are assigned to v2 train.

decisions.rationale: Across video groups, the sheet shows differing objects, camera overlays, seafloor geometry, or illumination; the equal dHash is attributable to coarse low-detail underwater appearance.
decisions.uncertainty: Manual visual review cannot prove independence, but no common scene/object sequence is visible.
